page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare metal instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8163 processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance is equipped with four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, providing a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM.

The server operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage solutions. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance type.

Given the presence of four NVIDIA T4 GPUs alongside 96 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs, this instance is designed for parallel computing tasks. It is suitable for workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, and distributed graphics rendering. The hardware profile offers a balance of multi-GPU acceleration and high vCPU density, making it a resource-dense option for enterprise-scale parallel processing without the cost overhead of higher-tier tensor-core GPUs.
